summary: US-SUF-06 — cannot-judge không tự thành permitted; đi tiếp phải bypassed + người + hạn
invariants: INV-ESO-02: cannot-judge NEVER becomes permitted automatically
BIP-4_6: bypass requires both owner (by) and deadline (expires_at)
AC-SUF-06-02: missing or empty by -> reject with BYPASS_NO_OWNER, 0 tasks run
AC-SUF-06-03: missing or empty expires_at -> reject with BYPASS_NO_EXPIRY, 0 tasks run
AC-SUF-06-04: past expiration deadline -> mode reverts to ask, never permitted
AC-SUF-06-05: exact clock match now == expires_at -> considered expired immediately (>= convention)
AC-SUF-06-06: duplicate bypass when first is still active is rejected, preserves original by and expires_at
BR-06: read-time calculation of effective mode, no mutation of immutable turn record

slices.name: Backend Implementation & Unit Tests
deliverables: Enhance applyOperatorBypass to reject missing by with BYPASS_NO_OWNER
Enhance applyOperatorBypass to reject missing expires_at with BYPASS_NO_EXPIRY

Implement getEffectiveMode(verdict, now) and evaluateEffectiveVerdict(verdict, now) with >= convention (AC-SUF-06-05) reverting to ask (AC-SUF-06-04)
Add unit test suite in eso/core/test/core.test.mjs covering all 6 ACs
